description: Source code for a byte buffer implementation, including memory management, buffer manipulation, and related utilities within the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: default_segment_pool_memory_resource
classes.description: Memory resource wrapper for the default byte buffer segment pool, managing allocation and deallocation with optional logging.

classes.name: default_fallback_segment_pool_memory_resource
classes.description: Memory resource wrapper for fallback allocation when the default pool is depleted, falling back to heap allocation.

classes.name: byte_buffer::control_block
classes.description: Internal control block managing segments, memory, and reference counting for byte_buffer instances.

classes.name: byte_buffer::node_t
classes.description: Node representing a segment within the byte_buffer, including data span and linked list pointers.

methods.name: byte_buffer::create
methods.description: Creates a new byte_buffer with a specified segment pool.

methods.name: byte_buffer::deep_copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the byte_buffer.

methods.name: byte_buffer::append
methods.description: Appends data or another byte_buffer to the current buffer.

methods.name: byte_buffer::add_head_segment
methods.description: Adds a new segment at the beginning of the buffer with specified headroom.

methods.name: byte_buffer::create_segment
methods.description: Creates a new segment with specified headroom and size hint.

methods.name: byte_buffer::resize
methods.description: Resizes the buffer to a new size, adding or removing segments as needed.

methods.name: make_byte_buffer
methods.description: Creates a byte_buffer from a hex string representation.

methods.name: to_span
methods.description: Converts a byte_buffer to a span of bytes, copying if necessary.
